Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Sunita - 35 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 46 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Ananya - 8 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
5. Rohan - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Sunita, Vinod and Rohan stand near him.]

Rishabh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rishabh slips and falls.]

Sunita (excited): "Rohan, are you okay?"

[Rishabh trips over a stone.]

Rishabh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh hurts his knee.]

Rohan (excited): "I knew it!"

[Rishabh helps Mother get up.]

Rishabh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh sneezes loudly.]

Rohan: "Really?"

[Rishabh coughs.]

Rohan (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
